kyb.verified_tooltip: KaamSathi checked this employer's company registration and PAN.
kyb.file_hint: JPG, PNG or PDF, up to {mb} MB
kyb.file_type: Upload a photo (JPG, PNG) or a PDF.
kyb.file_size: The file is larger than {mb} MB.
kyb.owner_only: Only the owner or an admin can manage employer verification.
kyb.page_description: Verify your organisation with its company registration and PAN to get worker shortlists and the Verified employer badge.
kyb.registration_no_hint: As printed on your OCR / municipality registration certificate.
kyb.pan_hint: 9-digit PAN from the Inland Revenue Department.
kyb.pan_on_file: On file: {pan}. Leave empty to keep it.
kyb.registration_doc_hint: A clear photo or scan of every page.
kyb.why_shortlist: KaamSathi sends worker shortlists only to verified employers.
kyb.why_badge: Workers see a Verified employer badge on your jobs.
kyb.why_trust: Verified employers get more applicants and fewer drop-outs.
kyb.privacy_note: Your documents are stored privately and seen only by KaamSathi verification staff.

status_body.unverified: Upload your registration and PAN certificates below. Review usually takes 1–2 working days.
status_body.pending: We are checking your documents. We will notify you when it is done.
status_body.rejected: We could not verify your organisation. Fix the issue below and resubmit.

kyb.submit_description: Documents must be in the organisation's name shown in KaamSathi.

employers.description: Review company registration and PAN documents, then verify or reject employers.
employers.search_placeholder: Search name, registration no. or PAN
employers.reject_note_required: Write the reason so the employer can fix it.
employers.checklist: Check: name matches, registration and PAN numbers match the documents, documents are legible and not expired. Links expire in 10 minutes — reopen to refresh.
employers.reject_hint: Say exactly what to fix, e.g. "PAN certificate is unreadable".

flags.description: Possible fraud found by automatic checks or raised by staff. A flag is a prompt to look — it never blocks anyone by itself.
flags.empty_hint: Checks run when workers are saved and every night at 04:00.
flags.subject: Record
flags.confirm_hint: Record what you found and what action was taken (e.g. worker suspended, employer warned).
flags.dismiss_hint: Explain why this is not fraud (e.g. brothers sharing a bank account).
flags.manual_description: Flag a record for the risk team to investigate.
flags.subject_id_hint: Copy the ID from the worker, employer or employment page URL.

taxonomy.description: Trades workers and jobs are tagged with. Codes never change; deactivate a trade to hide it from new jobs and sign-ups.
taxonomy.new_description: Add a trade to the national list.
taxonomy.code_hint: e.g. solar_technician — cannot be changed later.
taxonomy.code_immutable: Codes cannot change: jobs and worker skills refer to them.
taxonomy.active_label: Active — shown when posting jobs and adding skills
